lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah over the people left in Judah, and the commanders came to him at Mizpah.
Gedaliah swore an oath: do not fear the Egyptians, live in the land, serve Babylon, and it will be well.
In the seventh month, Ishmael came with ten men and killed Gedaliah at Mizpah.
All the people and the army commanders fled to Egypt for fear of the Chaldeans.
Evil-merodach released Jehoiachin from prison, spoke kindly to him, and let him dine at the king's table for one year.

wrong_details.true: for the rest of his life
